introduction: The following special conditions apply specifically to this project and supplement the standard terms.

terms.title: Design Direction Agreed On Site
terms.content: During the site visit on 5ᵗʰ October 2026, **Noble Architecture** and the Client sketched early concept options together and agreed the direction: a single storey rear extension across the full width of the house, replacing the conservatory; a two storey side extension on the corner side; and extra first floor space as a projection off the back of the side extension, on the corner side, where there is no neighbour. A first floor extension across the back of the existing house, and a roof extended back across its full width, were considered and ruled out because of their effect on the neighbour's light and privacy, the cost of replacing the whole roof, and the existing solar panels. The concept design will develop the agreed direction.

terms.title: Areas To Be Resolved At Concept Stage
terms.content: The ground floor rooms formed from the garage, the converted garage room, the utility and the new side space were not resolved on site. **Noble Architecture** will take the Client's requirements for this area again at the start of the concept stage. The concept will also look at the porch, the stairs and the space under them, and somewhere to keep the dog's things. The allocation of first floor rooms, including whether the family bathroom is kept, will be settled at concept stage.

terms.title: No Loft Conversion
terms.content: The concept design does not include a loft conversion or any use of the roof space. Loft conversions are specialist engineering work that needs a specialist roof survey, and this has not been priced. If the Client wants to explore converting the loft, this must be raised before the quotation is accepted, as it changes the survey, the design and the fee.
